latest_release.name: v1.59.0
latest_release.body:
## ✨ Features

- Minimal deferred MCP tools in ToolExecutionOperation [#13378](https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose/pull/13378)
- Configurable and per-start voice instructions for live-voice [#13375](https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose/pull/13375)
- Configurable GPT-Live endpoint, model and key [#13360](https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose/pull/13360)
- Filter session/list by client tags (ACP) [#13173](https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose/pull/13173)
- Stop, approval, and tool hook operations for goose-agent (GDK) [#13169](https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose/pull/13169)
- Resume completed delegates with a follow-up (subagent) [#13106](https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose/pull/13106)

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Honor HTTP(S) docs roots in goose-doc-guide [#13381](https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose/pull/13381)
- Use uncorrelated IN for session keyword search [#13373](https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose/pull/13373)
- Isolate session database initialization from application pool [#13324](https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose/pull/13324)
- Refresh Databricks OAuth tokens before they expire [#13328](https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose/pull/13328)
- Reword compaction prompt that Opus 5.5 refuses as distillation [#13340](https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose/pull/13340)
- Send Gemini thinking level and drop stream_options for Databricks [#13232](https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose/pull/13232)
- Address new cargo-deny advisories (zip8) [#13309](https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose/pull/13309)

## 📚 Documentation

- Correct SECURITY_PROMPT_THRESHOLD sensitivity direction [#12954](https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose/pull/12954)
- Blog post: Same Brain, Different Bill [#13197](https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose/pull/13197)
